messages:
Alex: us-west2 GPU pool reporting mass reboots ~10m ago. ~40% of P100 capacity offline, autoscaler flapping.
Priya: logs show kernel panics followed by image pull failures on a subset. Kube drains are timing out on 4 nodes.
Mateo: we have warm pools in eu-west1 and ap-northeast1. Recommend shifting non-critical traffic and enabling a lighter quant model as fallback.
Sam: agree — protect enterprise SLAs. We should only throttle non-SLA tenants and reduce model profiles for free/pro.
Jordan: propose emergency soft caps: free=0.4 rps, pro=0.9 rps, embeddings for non-SLA=0.25 rps. Enterprise: mark as degraded but no hard cap.
Alex: need one owner to apply changes. Priya volunteer? I’ll coordinate comms.
Priya: I can run the rate-limit job. Will wait for Jordan's final numbers then execute.
Riley: support prepping incident notes. Please send the top-50 QPS list. I’ll draft a proactive message for affected customers.
Casey: CS hold until we know which customers are impacted. Send prioritized list with billing/SLA flags.
Jordan: numbers confirmed. Also add model fallback q4_0-lite for non-enterprise.
Priya: running infractl now:
```
# emergency soft caps and fallback
infractl rate-limit apply --match "tier:free" --qps 0.4 --embeddings-qps 0.25 --note "emergency-us-west2-031826"
infractl rate-limit apply --match "tier:pro" --qps 0.9 --embeddings-qps 0.25 --model-fallback q4_0-lite
infractl rate-limit apply --match "tier:enterprise" --qps 10000 --note "enterprise-exempt"
```
Priya: job queued -> rl-job-1793456789. Deploy-bot will validate rollout across regions.
deploy-bot: started rl-job-1793456789. validating selectors, propagation to edge proxies, and per-tenant enforcement.
Mateo: initiating traffic shift: move ~18% of free/pro eligible traffic to eu-west1 warm pools. This should drop us-west2 pressure by ~22%.
Sam: heads up Finance — this may alter token billing distribution for the hour.
Riley: posted draft to #support-alerts with guidance and mitigation steps. tagging high-QPS tenants.
Alex: dashboards: QPS trending down, p95 latency slightly up. Queues reduced but keep an eye on retries.
Priya: node restarts are stabilizing; current capacity ~88% of baseline.
Jordan: we'll keep caps until capacity >=96% for 10m, then relax in staged increments.
Casey: sending top-50 list to Riley and Priya. CS ready to reach out to top 10 if needed.
Mateo: metrics: model-fallback rate currently 45% for non-enterprise, memory usage dropped ~28% for those flows.
Alex: plan: hold measures up to 60m max, reassess if capacity improves sooner. If anything regresses, update @channel.
Priya: update @ 32m: capacity at 93%. prepping staged rollback in 12m if stable.
